body: A wound around your voice and mind: a fear of not being smart enough or of never truly being heard.
business: You become a patient teacher and translator who makes others feel understood.
shadow: Over-explaining, or going silent rather than risk being dismissed.
policy: Modern point; secondary weighting only. Not used in dignity, sect, or time-lord logic, and never treated as a primary chart ruler. Weight up only when it aspects a personal planet or angle, or sits on an angle.
